verdict.rationale: Muse documents its own persona customization: users can name the agent, give it a unique style, and "shape how it talks." It also keeps a persistent, user-inspectable and editable memory about the user, which plausibly shapes later responses. However, there is no explicit custom-instructions or preferences feature that is documented to apply to every response. Missing for 10: an explicit persistent custom-instructions/preferences setting, documentation that preferences apply across all responses and side chats, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can set persistent custom instructions and preferences that shape every response

citations.quote: Name it, shape how it talks, and make it your own.
Creating our own avatar, naming it, and giving it a unique style has become one of the core features people light up about most.
You can inspect, edit and download these files freely, including Muse’s memory about you.
